name: ConfirmAsk
description:
Yes or no on a consequence the agent spells out. A destructive confirmation takes a second
step inside the card, never a dialog (R13.8): the soft entry point turns the consequence
into a danger notice and the footer into Back and the solid danger button. Esc goes back.

props.name: ask
props.type: { type: "confirm"; consequence: string; confirmLabel: string; tone: "warning" | "danger" | "accent"; } & { id: string; question: string; detail?: string; status?: import("../types.js").AskState; answer?: string; answeredBy?: string; answeredByEntity?: import("../types.js").EntityRef; answeredAt?: number; submitLabel?: string; }
props.description: The confirmation ask: the question, `consequence`, `confirmLabel` and `tone`; `danger` adds the in-card second step. Answers go to the `answer` conversation handler; once answered, expired or cancelled the card shows its record.
